title: UNIQON Billing Pro • Android Build 286 (Fingerprint Unlock on Launch & Lock App)
highlights: Fingerprint Unlock on Launch: Fixed startup security routing so that when Fingerprint Login is enabled in Settings, reopening the app prompts for fingerprint immediately without bypassing to Home.
Active Mobile Lock App: Fixed Logout / Lock App on Android to immediately lock to the security screen requiring Fingerprint or PIN to re-enter.
PIN Fallback Preservation: Preserved 6-digit PIN unlock option as a seamless fallback whenever fingerprint scanner is not used.
fixes: Checked getBiometricEnabled() during startup in main.dart to prevent silent auto-login when biometric is enabled.
Removed invalid startup password requirement bypass in AndroidSecurityUnlockScreen.
Updated mobile user menu action to 'Lock App' with a secure lock icon.
